answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond that is slashed if linked identities are detected coordinating. The bond acts as a beacon: honest agents signal one persistent stake, while a sybil swarm must split capital across many wallets, each posting its own bond. Like a comet with a plume of dust, coordinated fakes leave correlated timing and funding trails, so detection burns all their bonds, making the attack cost more than its reward.
